invariants: Every validated InterpretationBundle carries an explicit interpretationVersion independent from calculation engine versions.
Rendered interpretation item count must equal source rule ID count.
Blank items, blank rule IDs, duplicate rule IDs and unresolved {placeholder} tokens fail closed.
Exact duplicate normalized interpretation items fail closed.
Repeated normalized sentences beyond the configured frequency fail closed.
This structural guard does not claim semantic contradiction detection; domain-specific engines must model conflicting claims explicitly.
remaining_before_done: Exact Flutter test SUCCESS must be visible on the tested commit.
Domain-specific contradiction metadata/aggregation remains required for RC-1077 and RC-1078.
Production interpretation catalogs must pass their own TR/EN editorial and coverage audits.
